import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] data;
        int rows, cols;

        Matrix(int n) { this(n, n); }
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            rows = n; cols = m;
            data = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(Matrix other) {
            rows = other.rows; cols = other.cols;
            data = new long[rows][];
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                data[i] = other.data[i].clone();
            }
        }

        long get(int i, int j) { return data[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, long val) { data[i][j] = val; }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                res.data[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        void add(Matrix other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = (data[i][j] + other.data[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        void sub(Matrix other) {
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = (data[i][j] - other.data[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int r = rows, c = other.cols, k = cols;
            long[][] res = new long[r][c];
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < c; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                        sum = (sum + data[i][l] * other.data[l][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                    res[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            Matrix out = new Matrix(r, c);
            out.data = res;
            return out;
        }

        void powEquals(long exp) {
            Matrix base = new Matrix(this);
            Matrix result = identity(rows);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) != 0) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            this.data = result.data;
            this.rows = result.rows;
            this.cols = result.cols;
        }

        Matrix pow(long exp) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(this);
            res.powEquals(exp);
            return res;
        }

        void rotate(int K) {
            int sz = rows; // sz = K+1
            Matrix res = new Matrix(sz);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = data[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K];
                }
                res.data[i][K] = data[(i + K - 1) % K][K];
                res.data[K][i] = data[K][(i + K - 1) % K];
            }
            res.data[K][K] = data[K][K];
            this.data = res.data;
        }
    }

    static long power(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) != 0) {
            // Unchecked overflow is possible but follows original code
                result *= base;
            }
            base *= base;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();
        int Kint = (int)K;
        int log_ = 0;
        long temp = N;
        while (temp >= Kint) {
            log_++;
            temp /= Kint;
        }

        Matrix[][] mats = new Matrix[log_ + 1][Kint];
        mats[0][0] = Matrix.identity(Kint + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= Kint; i++) {
            mats[0][0].set(0, i, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < Kint; i++) {
            mats[0][i] = new Matrix(mats[0][i - 1]);
            mats[0][i].rotate(Kint);
        }

        for (int l = 1; l <= log_; l++) {
            mats[l][0] = new Matrix(mats[l - 1][0]);
            for (int i = 1; i < Kint; i++) {
                mats[l][0] = mats[l - 1][i].multiply(mats[l][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < Kint; i++) {
                mats[l][i] = new Matrix(mats[l][i - 1]);
                mats[l][i].rotate(Kint);
            }
        }

        Matrix result = new Matrix(Kint + 1, 1);
        result.set(Kint, 0, 1);
        int pos = 0;
        while (log_ >= 0) {
            while (true) {
                long p = power(Kint, log_);
                if (p <= N) {
                    N -= p;
                    result = mats[log_][pos].multiply(result);
                    pos = (pos + 1) % Kint;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            log_--;
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= Kint; i++) {
            total = (total + result.get(i, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
